verdict.rationale: Sketch's own docs describe a document history in which you can star versions to mark important updates, control which versions Viewers and Guests see, and choose which become Library updates. That covers the milestone-marking part of the story. Community mentions of git integration via the zipped-JSON format are a user-side workaround and earn no credit. Missing for 10: evidence of naming or describing versions, side-by-side comparison of versions, restoring any earlier state, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, full version history lets me name milestones, compare, and restore any earlier state of a file

citations.quote: With starred versions, you can indicate important updates in a document’s history, set which versions Viewers and Guests can see, and control which versions become Library updates for Editors.
When you star a version in a Library document, anyone using that Library will receive a Library update.
